invariants.rationale: records.collectAsList() should never return null and should always provide a valid List instance.
The method guarantees the return type is a List; this invariant enforces the contract.
collectAsList() collects all records from the HoodieData; the resulting List has the same number of elements as HoodieData.count().
If the input data is empty, the resulting list is also empty, and vice versa.
A List's size is always non-negative in Java.
